ITEM.PTXT: A pre-crash safety system (radar type) with millimeter wave radar has been adopted and is provided depending on the vehicle specification.

The pre-crash safety system predicts a collision with a vehicle or obstacle ahead and, before the collision, retracts the seat belts and performs brake assist control and brake control, reducing the impact in a collision.

During sudden braking, or when the ABS & traction actuator assembly (skid control computer) determines that vehicle control has been lost (spin condition, etc.), the seat belts are retracted to reduce the impact in a collision.

ENTRY.PTXT: Components
Function
Millimeter Wave Radar Sensor Assembly
Transmits and receives millimeter waves to recognize obstacles.
Distance Control Computer Assembly

Determines whether a collision is unavoidable based on information from each sensor, and sends operation request signals to the ABS & traction actuator assembly (skid control computer) and the seat belt control computer.
ABS & Traction Actuator Assembly (Skid Control Computer)
Sends control signals to the brake actuator based on signals from the distance control computer assembly. In addition, sends the emergency brake operation signal to the seat belt control computer.
Engine Control Computer
Sends the vehicle speed signal to the distance control computer assembly.
Combination Meter Assembly
Informs the driver of the system status.
Seat Belt Control Computer
Performs pre-crash seat belt control based on signals from the distance control computer assembly and the ABS & traction actuator assembly (skid control computer).
Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly (Pre-crash Seat Belt)
Retracts the seat belt with a motor before a collision.
Front Seat Inner Belt Assembly (Buckle Switch)
Detects whether the seat belt is fastened or unfastened.
Skid Control Buzzer
Sounds before and during pre-crash brake operation.
Pre-crash System Cancel Switch Assembly
When the switch is "ON", pre-crash brake operation is stopped.
